Name: The Cave Cult
Author: Frogmin14
Description:
Meet the two new aspiring sorcerers, Kacy and Rodger, as they try to build up a cult inside their cave lair. Will you help them with their mysterious schemes?

Mod Features:
[list]
[*]New Locations - There is a new cave location (and sublevels) in the forest where Kacy and Rodger live. The cave is initially inaccessible, but becomes accessible once Kacy and Rodger's questline is started.
[*]New Characters - Meet Kacy, the eccentric cult leader and her partner in crime, Rodger, the cold and levelheaded taskmaster. 
[*]New Weapon - A Ritual Dagger that can claim the souls of the slain to empower a special ritual.
[*]Questline - Follow the story of Kacy and Rodger as they try to form a cult and perform a mysterious ritual.
[/list]
